We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. Job Description:

Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Responsible for development, support and maintenance of one or more modules related to observability data points.
Optimize the application for maximum speed and scalability.
Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
Work closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to deploy and monitor applications in production environments.
Involving in life-cycle project delivery work that includes requirement analysis, designing, building, testing and deployment

5-6 years of experience, out of which at least 3 years of experience in Golang developer.

Good to have knowledge on Open Telemetry protocol, GRPC, HTTP 2.0
Experience on microservices architecture.
Experience working on front-end  features using react
Good to have knowledge using ML and LLMs.
Good to have knowledge on proxies like Envoy.
Good to have knowledge on Kafka, Apache pulsar.
Good to have knowledge on Clickhouse or any other Big data analytics tools.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
text:
About the team

Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.

The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.

About the role

You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.

We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.

As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.

Products you may work on

Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.

Responsibilities

• Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions

• Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause

• Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams

• Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky

• Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings

• Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts

• Take part in on-call

Requirements

• 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering

• Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)

• Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd

• Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster

• Scripting in Python, Go or Bash

• Basic Git and CI/CD experience

• Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved

• Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code

• Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again

• Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering

• Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

title: Site Reliability Engineer
text:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:What do you need to know about the role
This is an incident command role. You'll direct application and infrastructure teams during incidents making work assignments, prioritizing troubleshooting paths, and authorizing critical actions like rollbacks and regional failovers. The Site Health Engineering (Command Center) team serves as the operational and technical authority during PayPal's most critical incidents. We are a team of experienced infrastructure and reliability professionals who blend deep technical expertise with sound judgment under pressure, directing cross-functional engineering efforts across PayPal's core platforms and family of brands, including Venmo, Xoom, Zettle, and Braintree.

title: SDE3, Infrastructure Security Engineer (DevSecOps)
text:
About the team

Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.

The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.

About the role

You are an infrastructure engineer whose first instinct is security, and who builds rather than only operates. You have worked on banking, fintech, payments or similarly regulated products, where a misconfiguration is an incident and an audit is routine. Here you set what “secure” means across Sarvam’s infrastructure and build the automation that enforces it, so security is a property of the pipeline rather than a review step. You work closely with the compliance team.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time goes into building, and you guide engineering teams across Sarvam on security — setting standards, reviewing security-relevant work and mentoring engineers.

Responsibilities

• Define and enforce security baselines for Kubernetes, cloud accounts, container images and CI/CD across all clouds

• Write the policy gates in the delivery pipeline (OPA / Conftest, Kyverno or equivalent): network exposure, IAM, image provenance, secrets, data residency

• Own secrets and workload identity: Vault or cloud-native equivalents, rotation, short-lived and scoped credentials, no long-lived keys

• Build detection and response: runtime security (Falco / Tetragon or equivalent), log-based detections, alerting and playbooks

• Run the finding-to-fix loop for security findings: triage, assign, fix, add a detection, retest

• Use LLMs and AI agents in security work: triaging findings, reviewing infrastructure changes, tuning detections, drafting incident timelines — and secure the agents themselves with scoped, short-lived permissions and audit trails

• Harden the supply chain: image signing and scanning, dependency policy, SBOMs

• Automate compliance evidence (CERT-In, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DPDP) together with the compliance team

• Set the security standards other engineers follow and review security-relevant changes

• Take part in on-call and lead security incidents

Requirements

• 5–9 years in DevOps, platform or security engineering, with at least 2 in a bank, fintech, payments company or other regulated environment

• Strong Kubernetes and Linux fundamentals; has run production clusters on at least one major cloud

• Hands-on with Terraform / OpenTofu and GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux)

• Has built security automation, not only operated tools: policy-as-code, secrets rotation, CI/CD security gates or detection pipelines

• Working knowledge of IAM, network security, TLS and secrets management across clouds

• Scripting and tooling in Python or Go

• Has been through security audits and knows what evidence auditors need

• Has built or used AI-based automation in infrastructure or security work, and understands the risks of AI agents: prompt injection, over-broad permissions, unreviewed actions

• Nice to have: Vault, SPIFFE / SPIRE, Falco or Tetragon, Cloudflare WAF, incident response lead experience, multi-cloud experience

title: Backend Engineer Internship
text:
Overview: Supply Chain API and Microservices Development
The Backend Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for the development, scaling, and maintenance of the core API services that power our entire integrated platform. You will build highly reliable, secure, and performant backend services within the NestJS modular monolith, focusing on critical supply chain logic, complex payment integrations, and the orchestration backbone for our AI agents.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months 
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will own the backend development for the most complex domain logic, ensuring scalability and transactional integrity.

API Development & Implementation: Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable APIs for all platform components using Node.js 22 and NestJS within the TypeScript modular monolith. This includes the backends for the e-commerce checkout, internal tool APIs, and the B2B portal.

SCM Domain Logic: Implement complex, transactional business logic within the core supply chain modules: Order Management (OMS), Warehouse Management (WMS), and Manufacturing Execution (MES). Ensure data integrity using PostgreSQL 15.

Integrations & Payments: Implement secure, reliable integrations with third-party payment gateways and external shipping/logistics providers.

title: Container Engineer
text:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. More than 9 million developers and 250,000+ customers now build on Supabase, and the majority of new databases on the platform are created by AI app builders — so the systems underneath have to stay reliable while they grow fast.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Container Engineering (ConEng) owns the internal container platform that runs Supabase's multi-tenant, multi-region services — the managed Kubernetes platform that other engineering teams build and deploy on top of. We own cluster lifecycle and cluster classes, multi-cluster and multi-region topology, capacity, scheduling, isolation and runtime safety, the higher-level platform APIs, the Kubernetes deployment contract and Argo semantics, rollout primitives, and runtime configuration and secret injection.

 

Your job is to make the platform itself trustworthy, observable, and cheap to operate at scale — and to raise the reliability bar for everyone who depends on it. This is not a gatekeeper role. You'll make the reliable path the easy path: building the automation and platform APIs that let product teams run safely by default, instrumenting what we operate, and making sure that when something breaks we detect it and recover fast.

 

The work spans three strength areas:

Tooling & ecosystem — deep knowledge of the container and orchestration landscape (Kubernetes, containerd/OCI, the CNCF ecosystem) and a clear point of view on how to compose it.

Software engineering — designing and building the platform's automation, controllers, and internal tooling as production code, including solutions that don't come pre-shaped by an existing tool.

Operational / SRE practice — the discipline (SLOs, error budgets, incident response, ORRs) that runs the platform at scale as a predictable one.

We expect you to be genuinely deep in at least one of these, and many of our strongest candidates are deep in two (usually leaning toward one). Bringing real strength across all three is rare and exceptional — and even then, no one is equally strong in all three at once, so you'd focus where you're most needed at any given time. Different profiles are welcome here; tell us which of these is your center of gravity.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Regardless of the skill set, all team members carry a share of the team's on-call rota, responding to platform incidents and driving them to resolution and follow-up.

Platform reliability & operations

 - Define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for the container platform itself, and build error-budget policies that actually gate platform changes.

 - Own the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process for new platform capabilities and major changes.

 - Design and track metrics for platform uptime, and increase observability into the platform by capturing the right metrics, logs, and traces across the platform layers.

 - Drive the incident-to-improvement pipeline: facilitate blameless postmortems, connect findings to readiness gaps, spot repeat failure patterns, and push through systemic fixes.

Software engineering

 - Build and maintain the platform's automation, controllers, operators, and internal tooling — writing production code and shipping it, not just wiring together existing tools.

 - Design and implement the platform-side CI/CD and rollout primitives that speed up platform deployments while working within proper change and release management.

 - Implement and maintain security automation for the platform: intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management.

 - Identify and quantify operational toil, and build the automation that removes it rather than just documenting it.

 - Contribute to the platform's continual testing automation — the test suites and pipelin

title: Support Engineer (APAC - Weekends)
text:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We are seeking Support Engineers to provide world-class developer support for anyone experiencing issues or seeking guidance when using Supabase. The support team is globally distributed with a strong focus on minimizing time to fix, and works closely with the product engineering and growth teams.

You will:

 - Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to optimization or implementation questions.

 - Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members.

 - Monitor multiple feedback channels, e.g. Github Issues & Discussions (check them here: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues).

 - Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency.

 - Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing.

You are:

 - Experienced in customer support, with 3+ years of experience providing developer support to technical customers.

 - Proficient in SQL (ideally PostgreSQL). You feel comfortable with complex SQL queries. If you have a database administration experience, it’s a plus.

 - Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

 - Skilled in using Linux/Unix operating systems and the command line.

 - Experienced working with GitHub Issues and Discussions.

 - Bonus points if you're familiar with popular JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte and have some experience with Node.js.

 - Having a degree in Computer Science is a plus too.


TIMEZONES & LOGISTICS

 - It’s a full-time position permanently, with four 10-hour shifts covering weekends during APAC Hours: 00:00-10:00 UTC

 - We are primarily looking for someone in Southeast Asia or India time zones for this shift.

 - This position covers Friday → Monday based on the above UTC times, so this may vary slightly for your specific timezone.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

title: Test Automation Engineer- L2/L3 Networking
text:
Test Automation Engineer- L2/L3 Networking

  This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
What you will do :

Key Responsibilities

•             Design, develop, execute, and automate feature, platform, and system-     level test plans based on product, platform, and solution requirements.
Validate Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking features as part of broader system and solution workflows (e.g., switching, routing, resiliency, and high-availability scenarios).
Perform platform-related testing, including: Hardware bring-up, Interface, and forwarding-path verification, Boot, upgrade, ISSU, reboot, and recovery scenarios, Redundancy, failover, and scale testing
Develop and enhance test automation frameworks and reusable libraries using Python (PyTest preferred; Robot Framework is a plus).
Execute end-to-end solution testing, covering multi-device topologies, control-plane/data-plane interactions, and traffic validation.
Use networking test equipment (e.g., Spirent, Ixia) to generate and analyze traffic for functional, performance, and scale testing, and automate their usage where applicable.
Analyze failures, debug complex issues spanning software, hardware, and network layers, and collaborate with engineering teams on root cause analysis.
Document test coverage, results, defects, and risks; provide clear status updates to stakeholders.
Support customer escalations by reproducing issues in lab environments and validating fixes.

  What you need to bring :

•                Automation-first mindset: Strong experience in Python-based test automation (PyTest), with the ability to build and extend automation frameworks.
•                Networking fundamentals: Good understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 concepts such as Ethernet, VLANs, basic switching, IP routing, and routing adjacencies.
•                System thinking: Ability to validate not just individual features, but complete platforms and solutions.
•                Debugging skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities across platform, protocol, and system interactions.
•                Team collaboration: Clear communicator who works effectively with development, architecture, and customer-facing teams.
•                Adaptable learner: Comfortable picking up new features, platforms, and technologies as products evolve.
Technical Exposure (One or More Areas)
•                Layer 2 & Layer 3 Features: Exposure to common networking protocols and mechanisms such as VLANs, LAG/LACP, spanning-tree variants, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, ISIS), and basic multicast concepts.
•                Platform & System Validation: Hardware-software integration, control-plane and data-plane behavior, resiliency, scale, and performance testing.
•                High Availability & Resiliency: Validation of redundancy, failover,    convergence, and recovery scenarios across features and platforms.
•                Virtual & Modern Networking: Familiarity with EVPN/VXLAN, VPLS, or virtualized networking environments is a plus.
•                Test Infrastructure & Tools: Experience with traffic generators, lab automation, CI/CD-driven test execution, and result reporting.
